## News & Events

:::

<a href="news_archive.qmd" class="cw-section-link">View News Archive &rarr;</a>

:::

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import yaml
from datetime import date
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Load news announcements from YAML
with open("content/news.yml", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    news_data = yaml.safe_load(file) or {}

df = pd.DataFrame(news_data.get("news", []))

if not df.empty:
    # Parse publication dates
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce")
    df = df[df["date"].notna()]

    # Hide expired announcements from homepage
    today = pd.Timestamp(date.today())

    if "expiration" in df.columns:
        df["expiration"] = pd.to_datetime(
            df["expiration"],
            errors="coerce"
        )

        df = df[
            df["expiration"].isna()
            | (df["expiration"] >= today)
        ]

    # Sort newest first and show latest three
    df = df.sort_values("date", ascending=False).head(3)

html = '<div class="cw-news-grid">'

for _, row in df.iterrows():
    title = escape(str(row["title"]))
    description = str(row.get("description") or "")
    formatted_date = row["date"].strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    html += f"""
    <article class="cw-news-card">
      <div class="cw-news-card-body">
        <span class="cw-news-date">{formatted_date}</span>
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        <div class="cw-news-description">
          {description}
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
    """

html += "</div>"

display(HTML(html))
```
